b.sound: Subordinating conjunctions are words that link a main clause and a subordinate clause together.
Subordinating conjunctions are words that link two main clauses together.
Subordinating conjunctions always go at the beginning of the subordinate clause.
Subordinating conjunctions always go in the middle of the sentence.
Subordinating conjunctions always go at the end of the clause.
Subordinate clauses can be the first clause in the sentence, or the second.
Subordinate clauses must always be the second clause in the sentence.
Subordinate clauses must always be the first clause in the sentence.

hint.text:
A subordinating conjunction is a word that links a main clause and a subordinate clause together.
E.g. Annie went home because she felt sick.
Remember: a subordinate clause is a clause that cannot stand on its own.
